title: Admin Utility Palette: Runbook Task DSL and Contextual Shortcuts
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create an operator-facing 'Utility Palette' — a curated surface of safe, parameterized admin tasks backed by a lightweight Runbook Task DSL. The goal is to let support engineers discover contextual short-cuts, execute audited dry-runs, and invoke idempotent repairlets without leaving the Console. Deliverables: DSL runtime, palette metadata store, Console UI surface, dry-run simulator, permission gating and telemetry mapping.
technical_notes: DSL design: declarative JSON lines with typed inputs, preconditions and effect annotations (read-only | write | privileged)
Runtime will validate idempotency markers and simulate side-effects in dry-run mode by substituting mocked API clients; real runs require permission token with 'runlet:execute' scope
Persistence: palette entries stored in a namespaced metadata table (service + team + stable-key) to permit rollbacks and immutable history
Telemetry: emit intent and outcome events mapped to existing ops-telemetry schema (event.op_action, event.target, event.cost_estimate)
Safety: each palette item must declare required RBAC role, review_ticket (link) and an automated canary test (playback scenario)
progress_updates: 2026-02-10: RFC drafted and synced with PM/Design. Core use-cases: quick fixes, scoped rollbacks, KV cache invalidation, tenant quiesce.
2026-02-16: Prototype DSL runtime implemented (PoC) that supports run/dry-run and typed args. PoC passed unit tests for 6 canonical scenarios.
2026-02-20: Design review — Console surface mockups accepted with minor changes to approval flow (add inline justification + owner).
2026-02-25: Security review requested; created checklist for privileged operations and audit-event requirements.
2026-02-28: Backend PR opened (https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops-tooling/pull/214) implementing metadata table and dry-run simulator.
2026-03-01: Frontend integration spike complete; wiring to telemetry pipeline pending (blocked by ENG-412568 for event schema finalization).
acceptance_criteria: DSL specification doc published and approved by security and SRE
Backend exposes API to list palette items, fetch task input schema, run dry-run simulation, and execute with audit event generated
Console shows palette contextual suggestions for at least three support flows and supports dry-run + execute with inline justification
All privileged tasks require explicit RBAC and produce an immutable audit event with input redaction rules
Automated canary playback for two repairlets added to CI and green
blockers: Event schema finalization (ENG-412568) — telemetry events must include outcome and cost_estimate fields
KMS access gating review pending for privileged-run tokens
Need design sign-off on compact justification UX to avoid cluttering Console
notes_for_reviewers: Focus review on DSL safety model and permission model. Look for edge cases where dry-run could diverge from real-run (external callbacks, long-running jobs). Recommend review by SRE, security, and a support engineer representative.
implementation_plan: Phase 1 (2 sprints): DSL spec + runtime PoC, metadata table, dry-run simulator, API endpoints
Phase 2 (1 sprint): Console palette UI + justification flow + permission gating
Phase 3 (1 sprint): Telemetry integration, canary playback tests, security hardening
Phase 4: Pilot with 'support-oncall' team and iterate on ergonomics and required repairlets
